pages.title: Zombie Survival: Dead Hunt
pages.creator: ArcaneAegis
pages.description: Zombie Survival: Dead Hunt sends waves of undead toward you in a fight for the highest survival score. Shoot approaching zombies and keep moving to avoid being surrounded. Use WASD to move, aim with the mouse, and fire with the left mouse button. R reloads your weapon, while Space lets you jump as you try to stay alive longer.

pages.title: Arena Strike Battle
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Arena Strike Battle puts you in repeated arena gunfights with a choice of weapons, characters, and maps. Eliminate opponents to earn glory points and climb the leaderboard. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and left-click to shoot. Touch controls use separate movement and aiming sticks, with shots fired when you release the aiming stick.

pages.title: Hexa Associations
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Hexa Associations asks you to sort objects around category tiles on a hexagonal board. Drag one item onto another to exchange their positions, then build groups whose objects match the central category. An item that belongs to two categories needs a border position connecting it to both. Completed associations light up, and each layout must be solved before time runs out.

pages.title: Fruit Cafe: Match 3
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fruit Cafe: Match 3 is a layered tile puzzle where you collect sets of three identical fruits. Tap exposed tiles to move them into the bottom tray, uncovering more pieces beneath them. A completed trio disappears and awards coins. Clear the board while managing the tray's limited space: filling every slot without making a trio ends the attempt. Boosters can rearrange the board or help remove tiles.

pages.title: Math Master
pages.creator: Big Wave
pages.description: Math Master turns numbered pictures into region-filling puzzles. Drag across the pattern to mark a rectangular area containing one numbered clue, making its cell count match that number. Fit the regions together without overlapping completed sections or including a second clue. Cover the whole pattern correctly to finish the picture, and tap an existing region when you need to remove and redraw it.

pages.title: Fruit Jam Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fruit Jam Master challenges you to help every animal escape a grassland. The routes depend on food colors: an animal can pass through food only when its color matches its own. Work out which animals can leave and clear the way for the others until none remain. Use a mouse click or tap to play.

pages.title: Maze Escape Challenge
pages.creator: Reidga
pages.description: Maze Escape Challenge sends you through increasingly difficult labyrinths in a race to the exit. Hold and drag with a mouse or finger to guide the player around walls and traps. Faster finishes earn up to three stars, unlock later stages, and improve your best times. Some mazes use Dark Mode, restricting visibility to a small illuminated area around you.

pages.title: Word Connect Puzzle
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Swipe between letters in Word Connect Puzzle to discover the hidden words. Work through the puzzles to earn stars and open new packs as the difficulty increases. Hints help when you cannot find another word, while daily challenges offer additional puzzles. Build streaks to collect score bonuses as you continue connecting letters.

pages.title: Chiron City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Chiron City Driver lets you drive a customizable sports car through a morning city filled with traffic and driving challenges. Upgrade the car, bring your dog along on three challenges, and seek out speed, drift, and stunt triggers around the map. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, press F for nitro, and use C to change the camera.

pages.title: Noob: Skyblock Survival
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Noob: Skyblock Survival starts you on a floating block island that you can dig up, build on, and expand. Plant trees and wheat, combine water with lava to produce stone, and develop the island while preparing to fight zombies. You can also build a house. Move Noob with the arrow keys and use the mouse to dig or collect objects; touch controls divide movement and digging between the two sides of the screen.

pages.title: Block Puzzle King
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Block Puzzle King challenges you to empty a board by placing block pieces into its gaps. Drag shapes from the bottom of the screen and complete horizontal or vertical lines to remove those blocks. Keep fitting the available pieces into the remaining spaces until the entire board is cleared and the level is complete.

pages.title: Tap Tap Builder
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Tap Tap Builder makes you the mayor of a city built through repeated taps. Work on buildings such as skyscrapers, tap to earn money when funds run short, and respond to fires to protect the residents.

pages.title: Number Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Number Bubble Shooter combines aimed shots with number merging. Fire numbered balls onto the board and bring at least two matching values into contact to create a larger number. Keep merging to raise your score while leaving room for incoming balls. Rocket boosters clear a circular area when space becomes tight, and the run ends if the pile reaches the top.

pages.title: Bubble Plopper
pages.creator: Sanoma
pages.description: Bubble Plopper has you fire colored bubbles into groups of at least three to pop them. Classic mode challenges you to keep the playfield from filling, while Time attack mode asks you to clear it before the clock expires. An optional aiming assistant helps line up shots, or you can switch it off and judge the angles yourself.

pages.title: Word Search with hints
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Word Search with hints fills a letter grid with hidden words for you to uncover. Hold the first letter of a word and drag to its final letter to select it; correct selections color the matching cells. Find every word to finish a level. Earned coins can buy hints when a later puzzle leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Stickman Archer: Shooting Arrows at Reds
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Use a bow to drive enemy shooters out of ancient excavation sites in Stickman Archer: Shooting Arrows at Reds. Aim at the red opponents, release your arrow, and defeat every enemy to clear the level. Destructible objects in the surroundings can help you deal with the attackers, and boss encounters add tougher targets. Hold the left mouse button to aim and release it to fire.

pages.title: Archer Legend
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Archer Legend challenges you to clear stages by shooting monsters with a bow. Line up your aim, judge the shot, and release arrows at the enemies in each archery puzzle. You must defeat every opponent before moving on to the next level.

pages.title: Demolition Derby Derby
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Demolition Derby Derby is a physics-based destruction game where your targets are buildings and statues. Toss dynamite and send rocks crashing into structures, choosing where to strike to bring them down.

pages.title: Kids Coloring
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose colors and bring outline pictures to life in Kids Coloring. Select a pencil, brush, or fill tool to apply color in different ways, then switch shades as you work on the drawing. Picture themes include cars, animals, fish, flowers, and fruit.

pages.title: Clash of Stone
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Defend the hero’s homeland in Clash of Stone by firing a trebuchet at an invading skeleton army. Launch stones at the attackers and bring down the enemy force to protect the land.

pages.title: Idle Santa Factory
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Run a Christmas toy production line in Idle Santa Factory, overseeing assembly, packing, and distribution. Recruit elves to help make and package presents, then keep the factory moving as demand increases. Upgrade the machinery to improve production speed and the toys it makes.

pages.title: Gyro Maze 3d
pages.creator: Thirdeyeverse Technologies Pvt. Ltd
pages.description: Guide a ball through obstacle-filled mazes in Gyro Maze 3d. Use WASD to control its movement and work through the routes to progress through the levels. Power-ups become available along the way, while different backgrounds, skins, and effects let you change the game’s appearance.

pages.title: Zombie Hunter Survival
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Zombie Hunter Survival puts you against an ongoing assault of undead enemies. Fight to stay alive, collect useful loot, and improve your equipment and weapons as the opposition grows stronger. Special abilities give you additional ways to handle the zombies.

pages.title: Prom Night Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Prepare six friends for their end-of-school celebration in Prom Night Dress Up. Choose dresses and other fashion items for each girl, combining pieces to create a prom-night look. Click wardrobe choices to change an outfit and experiment with different styles for the group.

pages.title: Fashionista Makeup & Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Fashionista Makeup & Dress Up lets you build a fashionable look for a doll from a wardrobe of clothes and accessories. Try dresses, coats, shoes, and jewelry, then change individual pieces to see which combinations you prefer. Use the mouse to select clothing and put together an outfit.

pages.title: Mutant Snake
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Mutant Snake sends you into survival rounds against rival snakes. Guide your snake carefully and keep its head from running into opponents: a collision can eliminate it and scatter small dots. A speed control lets you accelerate while maneuvering among the other snakes.

pages.title: Urban Stack
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Build a city one floor at a time in Urban Stack. Tap the screen to drop each new storey onto the structure below, timing the placement to line it up neatly. Continue stacking floors to create buildings and add more structures to your city.

pages.title: Escape It!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Escape It! is a first-person escape puzzle set inside a room filled with objects to investigate. Search the surroundings for objects that can help you escape. Move with WASD, left-click to interact, and press I to open your inventory. The inventory also provides hints to help when you are stuck.

pages.title: Angry Farm Crossy Road
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: The chickens have escaped in Angry Farm Crossy Road, and the farmer needs help bringing them back. Guide the farmer to drive the birds toward the farm while taking care around the road. Gather eggs along the way. Slide to move and use A to shoo the chickens.

pages.title: Tank War Multiplayer
pages.creator: GameFlare.com
pages.description: Tank War Multiplayer combines 3D tank combat with a capture-the-flag objective. Drive onto the battlefield, seize the opposing side’s flag, and bring it back to your base while fighting enemy tanks. Use WASD to move and the mouse to shoot as you take part in the online battle.

pages.title: Cinderella Match 3D
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Cinderella Match 3D asks you to find matching pairs of shoes and organize them on a rack. Drag shoes onto the stand, working through heels, flat shoes, sneakers and other styles. Pairing the shoes unlocks additional designs.

pages.title: Tomb of The Cat
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Race for the exit in Tomb of The Cat, a retro arcade game with timed levels. Collect gold along your route, but keep the door as your priority: reaching it before the clock expires lets you advance. You can leave some coins behind rather than lose the chance to escape.

pages.title: Penguins Jump Escape
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Penguins Jump Escape combines a jumping run with a score challenge. Use the mouse or Space key as your character travels along the track. Try to push your score higher before the character’s life runs out and ends the run.

pages.title: Color Raid
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Lead a team through obstacles and rival groups in Color Raid. Guide your participants through the required colors to multiply their numbers, then take the enlarged team into fights with opponents.

pages.title: Puppy Blast Lite
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear colored blocks in Puppy Blast Lite by selecting groups of two or more matching pieces. Its puzzles introduce different colored squares and objects as the boards become more complicated. Work through the increasingly difficult challenges to unlock higher achievements.

pages.title: Rescue The Beauty Girl
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Search a forest for a missing girl in Rescue The Beauty Girl. Examine the grass for hats, bows, shoes, rings and other objects that may help you track her down. Use what you collect to solve riddles and decipher codes, turning the scattered belongings into clues for the rescue.

pages.title: Advent Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Advent Mahjong is a Christmas-themed connection puzzle in which each completed level advances you one day toward the holiday. Remove identical tile pairs whose connecting path needs no more than three straight segments. Rotation boxes and arrow controls let you rearrange tiles, while the levels become harder as Christmas approaches.

pages.title: Amogus.io
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Amogus.io sends you to claim territory on the YRZ-15 space station. Leaving your own area creates an exposed trail that enemies can strike to eliminate you and free your territory. Attack rival trails while protecting your own, expand your borders and aim to control the largest part of the station to earn the crown.

pages.title: Impostor Differences
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Impostor Differences challenges you to spot small changes in scenes featuring impostors and crewmates. Search across ten levels and select the details that differ. Each correct discovery receives a circle so you can track what you have found, but three incorrect clicks end the game.

pages.title: Monsters Run
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Move a small monster between the upper and lower parts of a track in Monsters Run. Spikes and saws threaten both sides, so switch position according to the obstacles ahead. Collect stars and travel as far as you can to raise your score. Taking a hit sends you back to the beginning.

pages.title: Zoo Pinball
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Zoo Pinball puts animal targets around a pinball table. Swipe to launch the ball, then tap the left and right sides to operate the flippers. Build your score by hitting bouncers and directing the ball toward the mouths of the lion, tiger and hippo for larger point rewards.

pages.title: Princess Halloween Makeup HalfFaces Tutorial
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create two looks on one face in Princess Halloween Makeup HalfFaces Tutorial. Harlequin, Snow White and Tropical Princess are preparing for Halloween with makeup that depicts a different character on each half of the face. Join their makeup workshop and put together the contrasting sides of these split-face designs.

pages.title: Moba Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Select a hero and face an AI-controlled opponent in Moba Simulator. The game presents MOBA-style strategic combat, with spells assigned to Q, W, E and R. Use the mouse to play, scroll to change the zoom and open the shop with S.

pages.title: Funny Eye Surgery
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Eye Surgery puts you in the role of an eye doctor helping Luke and Lora. The children have developed eye problems after spending too much time with screens and giving their eyes little rest. Complete their treatment in this fictional doctor game and help both patients see better.

pages.title: Animal Skins
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Animal Skins is an animal-matching game focused on recognizing different skin types. Look at the animal shown and click the skin that belongs to it, comparing the available choices before making your selection.

pages.title: Mineblock Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mineblock Adventure follows Steve through running and jumping platform levels. Collect money along the route and avoid the enemies between you and the finish line.

pages.title: Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival is a shooter with AI-controlled soldiers and zombies, along with multiplayer battles. Choose modes such as Survival, Gun Game, Deathmatch or Team Deathmatch, and use weapons with camouflage and attachments. Move with WASD, aim and shoot using the mouse, jump with Space and run with Shift. Tab opens the menu.

pages.title: Monster head soccer volleyball Game
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Monster head soccer volleyball Game is a ball-sport duel between your chosen character and a computer opponent. Move around your side of the court and jump to meet the ball, sending it across the central divider. The match tracks both scores and a countdown, so try to finish ahead before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Ultimate Off Road Cargo Truck Trailer Simulator
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Ultimate Off Road Cargo Truck Trailer Simulator puts you behind the wheel of heavy trucks in an open off-road environment. Choose among different trucks and tackle driving levels on hilly routes. Control the vehicle over uneven terrain and through climbs, then switch off the engine at the finish to complete the level.

pages.title: US City Garbage Cleaner: Trash Truck 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: US City Garbage Cleaner: Trash Truck 2020 puts you in charge of collecting waste with a garbage truck. Use the arrow keys to drive around the city and reach collection spots, then operate the pickup control to gather the rubbish.

pages.title: Drawaria.online
pages.creator: Icaneefoeva Ecleausu
pages.description: Drawaria.online is a multiplayer drawing-and-guessing game built around secret words. Players take turns drawing while everyone else tries to identify the word before time expires. Correct guesses earn points, with extra points for the quickest answers, and the highest total after a series of rounds wins. Draw with the left mouse button, erase with the right button and change brush size with the mouse wheel.

pages.title: Color Clock
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Color Clock tests your timing against a moving clock hand. Click or tap when the hand reaches a section of the clock that matches its color. Watch the hand's position and color together to choose the right moment.

pages.title: Cargo Truck: Euro American Tour (Simulator 2020)
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Cargo Truck: Euro American Tour (Simulator 2020) has you transport freight by truck. Wait while the cargo is loaded, then follow the arrows to the next point on the route. Arrive at the unloading location to complete the delivery, guiding the truck between its loading and drop-off stops.

pages.title: 90 Degrees Escape
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: 90 Degrees Escape challenges you to dodge approaching objects using right-angle turns. Click or tap to change direction by 90 degrees, timing each maneuver to avoid the next obstacle.

pages.title: Ninja Jumper
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Ninja Jumper has you guide a ninja through a jumping escape. Click the mouse or tap the screen to control the jumps, collecting fruit along the way while avoiding the weapons in your path.

pages.title: Jewels Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Jewels Match 3 asks you to clear the board's dirty cells before the timer expires. Swap jewels to form rows or columns containing at least three of the same type. Locked jewels cannot be moved, so plan matches around those restrictions. Certain match shapes create special symbols, including bombs, that add more ways to clear the board.

pages.title: Sweet Sugar Rush
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Sweet Sugar Rush is a candy-connecting puzzle. Join matching candy beans to collect them, looking for pieces of the same type that you can link together.

pages.title: Chess Grandmaster
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Chess Grandmaster offers full chess matches against a computer opponent and a separate collection of checkmate problems. Play a classic game against its custom AI or tackle puzzles that ask you to find mate in two, three or four moves. The puzzle mode narrows the task to choosing the winning sequence from a prepared position.

pages.title: Raccoon Adventure City Simulator 3D
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Raccoon Adventure City Simulator 3D lets you explore a city and the nearby forest as a raccoon. Find food to keep the animal fed, stay out of trouble in town, and watch for predators in the woods. Helping other raccoons contributes to your animal’s development and strength as you continue exploring.

pages.title: Barnyard Differences
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Barnyard Differences asks you to spot seven changes between a pair of pictures. Search each scene carefully and mark the details that do not match. There are ten levels, with one minute to find every difference in each round, so you need to balance close observation with the ticking clock.

pages.title: Real Car Race Game 3D : Fun New Car Games 2019
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Real Car Race Game 3D : Fun New Car Games 2019 takes place on an endless highway filled with traffic. Drive your car along the eight-lane road, steering through the vehicles ahead as you continue down the highway.

pages.title: Dragon Flight Race
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Dragon Flight Race puts you in control of a dragon traveling across uneven tracks in a fantasy landscape. Use the mouse to guide it along the course, collecting coins that can unlock more levels. Work on covering the distance quickly to improve your ranking.

pages.title: Motocross
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Motocross sends you onto snowy bike courses with eight levels to finish. Ride across the terrain and use jumps to get through sections where ordinary driving is not enough. Play with the arrow keys and Space, or use the touchscreen controls.

pages.title: Granny Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Granny Jigsaw contains twelve picture puzzles that unlock in sequence. Start with the first image, put its pieces together, and open the next puzzle. Every picture offers three sizes: 25 pieces for Easy, 49 for Medium, and 100 for Hard. Choose the piece count that suits the challenge you want to tackle.

pages.title: Pirate Run
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Pirate Run is an island platform game about gathering diamonds while avoiding a treasure guard. Move the pirate around the island and collect the gems as the challenge becomes harder over time. Keep clear of the guard and try to build the highest score you can.

pages.title: Rail Blazers Runner
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Rail Blazers Runner combines running along monorail and subway tracks with water racing sections. Routes can spread across as many as five lanes, and the activities include surfing, speedboat riding, flying, hovering, and bonus rounds. Use the arrow keys to move.

pages.title: EG Math Kid
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Math Kid turns arithmetic problems into drag-and-drop exercises. Look at the displayed problem, choose the correct number from the available answers, and drag it into the missing position. A correct placement completes the exercise and takes you back to the lesson menu.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Stomach Care
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Stomach Care follows Hazel after she develops a stomachache from eating peanuts instead of her breakfast. Help her visit the doctor, take the in-game medicine, and get some rest. Respond to her requests before she starts crying, using the happiness bar to keep track of how content she feels during her care.

pages.title: Watermelon Shooting 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Watermelon Shooting 3D is a target-shooting game in which watermelons take the hits. Use a selection of handguns to shoot the fruit and break it apart, splashing red juice as you hit your targets.

pages.title: BTS Truck Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Truck Coloring lets you paint a truck picture in your own colors. Use the mouse or tap to color the drawing and decide how the vehicle should look.

pages.title: Princess Make Cup Cake
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Make Cup Cake takes you from shopping for ingredients to decorating homemade cupcakes. Help the princess collect what she needs, prepare the cakes in her kitchen, and add the decorations you prefer to finish them.

pages.title: Truck and Diesel
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Truck and Diesel challenges you to keep a truck moving while collecting fuel and avoiding road obstacles. Click or tap to shift the vehicle up or down, lining it up with diesel pickups and steering clear of walls. Keep the truck away from hazards while trying to raise your score.

pages.title: Swing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Swing is a rope-swinging game about making your way through a series of stages. Use the rope to carry yourself past hazards, release it to move onward, and collect coins along the route. Reach the end without crashing to complete the stage. The left mouse button or space bar controls the swinging action.

pages.title: Sweet Tooth Rush
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Sweet Tooth Rush follows a dinosaur racing downhill through a wintry landscape in search of candy. Collect sweets and bonuses while moving around obstacles as the descent picks up speed. Use the keyboard cursor keys to move and jump, or tap the upper part of the screen to jump and the sides to move left or right.

pages.title: Princess Bridal Hairstyle
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Bridal Hairstyle puts you in charge of Princess Emma’s hair on her wedding day. Take the role of her bridal stylist and use the mouse to create a hairstyle for the ceremony.

pages.title: Slice of Zen
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slice of Zen challenges you to cut away enough of an object to meet the target for each level. Choose where to make your slices and remove portions of the shape until you reach the required amount. More than 20 levels introduce different objects to cut.

pages.title: OMG Word Pop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: OMG Word Pop is an English word puzzle in which you tap and drag to spell answers. Early levels ask for a single word; later puzzles require two or more, with increasingly complicated words to work out. Build your score to unlock hints when a word has you stuck.

pages.title: Chroma Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chroma Challenge asks you to bounce a ball through gates that only let a matching color pass. Tap to jump and wait for the colors to align before moving through a gate. Touching an obstacle bursts the ball, so each jump needs careful timing. Collect stars as you make your way through the challenge.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Summer
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Summer offers 16 summer-themed pictures to reconstruct. Work out where the scattered pieces belong and fit them together to restore each image.

pages.title: Playgrounds Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Playgrounds Hidden Stars turns five playground pictures into search puzzles. Look closely through each scene and find every concealed star as you work through the set of images.

pages.title: Ice-O-Matik
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Ice-O-Matik puts you in charge of an ice cream machine serving waiting customers. Read each order, press the machine’s buttons in the right sequence, and sell the finished ice cream. If you make it incorrectly, cancel the creation and try again. Serve customers before the timer expires and meet the level’s goal to advance.

pages.title: Parking Fury 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Parking Fury 2 challenges you to steer cars into vacant parking spaces without hitting nearby vehicles or obstacles. Use the keyboard to control each car and guide it into the required spot.

pages.title: Hit the ape
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Hit the ape is a score challenge in which you use a small coconut to strike apes. Hit as many as you can and try to improve your best result.

pages.title: Galaxian Match
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Galaxian Match is a space-themed matching puzzle with goals to complete before time runs out. Make combinations of matching pieces to score points and satisfy each stage’s requirements. Some stages have several goals, and all must be met to win. Special pieces add effects such as clearing nearby pieces, changing their types, or combining with any piece.

pages.title: Modern Princess Superstar
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Modern Princess Superstar asks you to dress the Ice Queen for a movie awards ceremony. Browse her dresses and coordinate the outfit with shoes, a bag and jewelry. Choose the combination you want her to wear for the event.

pages.title: Rachel Shopping Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Rachel Shopping Day takes you shopping with Rachel during the seasonal sales. Help her choose a new outfit from the clothes presented by the store’s staff. Finish the look with high heels and accessories, combining the available pieces into a complete style for her.
